page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating substantial data throughput. The instance does not include graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers a high volume of local storage capacity relative to its compute and memory resources. However, because the storage is HDD-based rather than SSD-based, workloads requiring high random IOPS may experience latency bottlenecks. The use of the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 architecture represents an older hardware generation, which may impact per-core performance compared to newer processor families.

This hardware profile is engineered for workloads that demand vast sequential storage capacity and moderate compute capabilities. Suitable use cases include large-scale data warehousing, log processing, distributed file systems, cold data archiving, and big data analytics frameworks that benefit from high-capacity local storage and a 20 Gbps network interface.
